scope: SB02 bounded actual capability observation only, proposed role not granted
source_commit: Final SOURCE delta commit must be recorded before snapshot export; source file hashes bind the prospective contract now.

construction.context: Owned public snapshot exported from final SOURCE commit after source acceptance. It includes exactly the reviewed public construction inputs at their recorded hashes. Build uses reviewed Dockerfile and .dockerignore; no host checkout bind in verifier. If the coordinated root already builds the matching controller image, reuse it only after verifying identical construction and baked-input hashes.
record: built immutable image ID and image inspect
baked shell/profile/start hashes via owned offline inspection

bounds.build_slot: Separate exclusive construction role; this proposal does not treat build daemon cost as bounded by the verifier limits.

read_only.inside: Reviewed shell issues only docker info with fixed projection and 15 second bound; runtime mode never runs Compose. It reads root/socket/cgroup/sysfs metadata only.
read_only.outside: Read existing canonical socket/root before creation; image/container inspect, logs and exact-owned resource inventory.
read_only.socket_caveat: Readonly socket mount does not restrict Docker API authority. Trusted reviewed source and exact commands constrain this observation.

mutations.build: Creates exact owned image tag and performs Dockerfile public package/image retrieval as needed. Build requires coordinated exclusive runtime role. No Docker daemon settings are changed.
mutations.container: Creates/starts/removes only one fresh named resource-bounded verifier. Verify exact CID, image ID and ownership labels before removal.
mutations.cleanup: After capturing exit/output/inspect, remove only verified owned CID; remove only owned tag after image identity matches. No global prune or ID-less cleanup.

refusal_and_limits: A shell refusal is retained as failure, no bypass or daemon change.
Unknown driver or containerd content-root/headroom remains admission unproven, no arbitrary profile narrowing.

No UID/mode/xattr/rename/fsync crash persistence, actual resource enforcement, clean-host install, service startup, reboot, reconnect, full recovery or production acceptance follows from this observation.
Missing runtime role, independently reviewed final command or exact built-source identity blocks execution.
before_create: Refuse if proposed name or image tag already exists; never take over an existing resource.
Verify final source commit and public snapshot hashes, build completion and image immutable ID.
Record before image/container/volume/network inventory; no application-private resource content is inspected.
Set no alternate Docker context/TLS/API configuration; all actual argv uses the declared local endpoint.
after_execute: Capture exact CID inspect, verified image ID, ownership labels, exit status, stdout/stderr and before/after inventory.
If attached execution times out, retain the timeout failure then inspect and remove only the verified owned CID.
Require exact CID, name, source label and image ID match before cleanup; any mismatch stops cleanup pending reconciliation.
Capture confirmation exact owned verifier absent and owned tag removed; do not delete the immutable image ID if other tags/resources use it.
